text:
Solar heating panels consist of pipes carrying water that absorb radiation from the Sun.
Which texture and colour is the surface of the pipes so that the temperature of the water rises at
the quickest rate?
A
dull black
B
dull white
C
shiny black
D
shiny white
subject: Physics
